messages:
sylvie: Quick follow-up from the postmortem for the missing spans + bad-aggregation incident. Need clear owners, short timelines, and a durable regression check. Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-5842 :memo:
kevin: I can own the ETL backfill and per-row correctness validation. Plan: targeted backfill for affected partitions, then run an equivalence check against raw_events. ETA: Thu EOD.
marisol: I'll take aggregation test coverage. Adding unit tests for group-by edge cases and an integration test that runs in staging. Also propose a nightly smoke test that runs a synthetic trace through the pipeline.
olivia: I'll own monitoring + runbook updates. Proposal: add a weekly "span-coverage" batch that computes processed_span_count vs raw_events baseline and alert if drop >15% sustained 20m. Also add a playbook section for partition reprocessing.
sylvie: Please create obs-remediations tickets and tag postmortem:INC-5842. Quick fixes should have <=7d ETA; long-term engineering fixes get the long-term label.
kevin: Backfill SQL I'm using (targeted):
```sql
-- insert missing spans for partition 2026-03-18
INSERT INTO spans_agg (trace_id, span_id, start_ts, service, payload)
SELECT r.trace_id, r.span_id, r.start_ts, r.service, r.payload
FROM raw_events r
LEFT JOIN spans_agg s ON s.trace_id = r.trace_id AND s.span_id = r.span_id
WHERE r.event_type = 'span' AND r.partition_date = '2026-03-18' AND s.trace_id IS NULL;
```
I'll post row counts + runtime estimate in OBS ticket.
marisol: CI plan: nightly synthetic trace job asserting >=99.9% span preservation and that aggregation bucketing matches expected counts. If it fails, CI auto-opens OBS-CI tickets.
runbook-bot: Created OBS-1290: "span-coverage-weekly" assigned to olivia (due 2026-03-24).
runbook-bot: Created OBS-1291: "etl-targeted-backfill" assigned to kevin (due 2026-03-22).
sylvie: Weve seen similar incidents 4 times in 8 months. Recommend a monthly 30-min "obs-regressions" sync to track recurrence trends and decide structural work (partitioning changes, compaction guards, stronger end-to-end tests). Who can commit?
kevin: I'll attend monthly and bring partition skew stats and backfill costs.
marisol: I'll join and bring CI failure history + test coverage matrix.
olivia: I'll host the first session and book 30-min. Agenda: (1) frequency and impact of regressions, (2) alert/test gaps, (3) ownership model for remediations.
sylvie: Perfect. Everyone drop 2 bullets in the assigned ticket by tomorrow noon summarizing scope, ETA, and blockers. I'll compile and escalate to infra/product if we need extra capacity or prioritization. :thumbsup:
kevin: One note  I found a compaction job backlog in one partition that likely caused the lag; including remediation steps in ticket.
marisol: If backfill compute is heavy we'll ask infra for short-term burst capacity. I'll list the approvals needed.
olivia: Added runbook checklist for forcing reprocess and steps to validate post-backfill counts. Also added owner rotation: 2-week rotation for observability remediations.
sylvie: Great. I'll kick off 3 weekly check-ins after owners post their bullets. Thanks all, closing thread for now ":rocket:"
